final: WITH obs_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, COUNT(*) as num_observatories FROM obs_counts) SELECT obs_counts.observstation, obs_counts.telescope_count, ROUND(obs_counts.telescope_count * 1.0 / totals.total_telescopes, 6) as share, ROUND((obs_counts.telescope_count * 1.0 / totals.total_telescopes) - (1.0 / totals.num_observatories), 6) as difference_from_avg FROM obs_counts CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
